en: A black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard showing a modernist two‑storey building, likely a hotel or roadside restaurant. The main upper panel depicts the full exterior with a flat roof, large ribbon windows, and a central entrance; a few people stand near the entry and several mid‑20th‑century cars are parked to the right. The lower strip contains three interior views: a distinctive circular wooden dining table with tall carved chairs under a heavy ring‑shaped ceiling feature; a cozy café area with wood‑panelled walls, framed decorative motifs, and hanging globe lamps; and a bar with curved stools, elaborate pendant lamps, and garlands or bead strings hanging from the ceiling.
